title: A&C Core Offers Frontmatter
description: Extends the base contract with display metadata for the Core Offers (services) document. Applies to documents under core-developer-portal/go-to-market/. The Core Offers are authored as a single document per language; this schema governs that document's frontmatter. This file is the single source of truth: the org CI validator enforces it on that path, and the website derives its Zod schema from it.

title.description: Document title used as the Services page heading.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'approved' documents are published to the public site.

source_doc.description: Provenance of the content (origin document, note, or generation method).

lang.description: Primary language of the document; drives the site's i18n routing (/es, /en).

summary.description: One-line value proposition shown in the Services page hero and meta description.

hero_image.description: Path or key to an abstract, NDA-safe visual for the Services page header.
